title: Trump’s Plan to Withdraw Troops From Syria

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日商业通讯

sentences.zh: 《DealBook》的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市DealBook峰会的现场，采访多位在商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领袖，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、佐兰·蒙达尼等众多嘉宾。

sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbar.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today,
sentences.zh: 今天，

sentences.en: President Trump's decision to withdraw U.S.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统决定从叙利亚撤出美军，

sentences.en: troops from Syria surprised everyone involved.
sentences.zh: 让所有相关人员都感到震惊。

sentences.en: From U.S.
sentences.zh: 从美国的

sentences.en: allies to enemies.
sentences.zh: 盟友到敌人。

sentences.en: And has prompted his own aides to publicly disagree with them.
sentences.zh: 并且促使他自己的助手公开表示反对。

sentences.en: But the debate it kicked off about the role of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但它引发的关于美军角色的辩论，

sentences.en: military may be long overdue.
sentences.zh: 或许早就该进行了。

sentences.en: It's Monday, January 7th.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月7日，星期一。

sentences.en: On the morning of December 19th, as Washington was getting ready for a government shutdown,
sentences.zh: 12月19日清晨，正当华盛顿准备迎接政府关门之时，

sentences.en: millions of Americans were getting ready for the holidays, we started getting word in the
sentences.zh: 数百万美国人正准备欢度假期，我们驻华盛顿记者站开始收到消息称，

sentences.en: Washington Bureau of a major announcement on foreign policy that President Trump was going to
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统将

sentences.en: abruptly withdraw all 2,000 American troops currently deployed in Syria to fight against the Islamic State.
sentences.zh: 突然撤回目前部署在叙利亚、用于打击“伊斯兰国”的所有2000名美军。

sentences.en: Mark Landler covers the White House for The Times.
sentences.zh: 马克·兰德尔为《时报》报道白宫新闻。

sentences.en: We heard about it initially just through sources.
sentences.zh: 我们最初只是通过消息源听到这个消息。

sentences.en: Although a couple hours later...
sentences.zh: 尽管几个小时后……

sentences.en: We do have confirmation in a statement just a short time ago.
sentences.zh: 就在不久前的一份声明中，我们确实得到了证实。

sentences.en: Sarah Huckabee Sanders, the press secretary, confirmed it in a very skeletal two-sentence statement.
sentences.zh: 新闻秘书萨拉·赫卡比·桑德斯在一份非常简短的两句话声明中予以了证实。

sentences.en: We have started returning United States troops home as we transition to the next phase of this campaign.
sentences.zh: 随着我们向这场战役的下一阶段过渡，我们已经开始将美军撤送回国。

sentences.en: And it wasn't until 6.30 in the evening that the president himself actually weighed in.
sentences.zh: 直到傍晚6点30分，总统本人才真正发表了看法。

sentences.en: We've been fighting for a long time in Syria.
sentences.zh: 我们在叙利亚已经战斗了很长时间。

sentences.en: I've been president for almost two years, and we've really stepped it up.
sentences.zh: 我担任总统快两年了，我们确实加大力度。

sentences.en: President Trump posted a video filmed outside the White House in which he said...
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统发布了一段在白宫外拍摄的视频，他在视频中说……

sentences.en: And we have won against ISIS.
sentences.zh: 我们已经战胜了ISIS。

sentences.en: We've beaten them, and we've beaten them badly.
sentences.zh: 我们打败了他们，而且狠狠地打败了他们。

sentences.en: We've taken back the land.
sentences.zh: 我们已经收复了领土。

sentences.en: The war against ISIS is over.
sentences.zh: 针对ISIS的战争已经结束。

sentences.en: So our boys, our young women, our men, they're all coming back, and they're coming back now.
sentences.zh: 所以我们的男孩、我们的年轻女性、我们的男儿，他们都要回来了，而且现在就要回来。

sentences.en: And it's time to bring the troops home.
sentences.zh: 是时候把军队带回家了。

sentences.en: We won.
sentences.zh: 我们赢了。

sentences.en: We want to turn now to that surprise decision by President Trump to withdraw all U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们现在要转向特朗普总统突然决定从叙利亚撤出所有美军一事。

sentences.en: troops from Syria.
sentences.zh: 叙利亚。

sentences.en: This morning there is growing outrage even from the president's own allies.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，甚至连总统自己的盟友也发出了越来越多的愤怒声音。

sentences.en: His announcement was greeted across the political spectrum with howls of protest and condemnation.
sentences.zh: 他的宣布在整个政坛引发了一片抗议和谴责的狂潮。

sentences.en: I've agreed with most all of President Trump's foreign policy and national security decisions.
sentences.zh: 我同意特朗普总统绝大多数的外交政策和国家安全决策。

sentences.en: Donald Trump's supporters tend to be, across the board, hawkish, patriotic, and pro-military.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普的支持者普遍倾向于强硬、爱国且亲军方。

sentences.en: All that said, this is a huge strategic mistake.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，这是一个巨大的战略错误。

sentences.en: This is a deeply unpopular move with the military and with kind of traditional hawks.
sentences.zh: 这对军方和传统强硬派来说是一个极不受欢迎的举动。

sentences.en: Well, why is he?
sentences.zh: 嗯，他为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: Nobody thinks that ISIS is defeated.
sentences.zh: 没有人认为ISIS已经被击败。

sentences.en: Many of the commentators that normally line up behind President Trump on foreign policy came on to Fox.
sentences.zh: 许多平时在外交政策上支持特朗普总统的评论员纷纷上福克斯新闻频道。

sentences.en: Why would you pull out a job halfway done?
sentences.zh: 为什么要把做到一半的工作半途而废？

sentences.en: To say that they had misgivings and that they opposed the way the president did this.
sentences.zh: 表达他们心中的疑虑，并反对总统处理此事的方式。

sentences.en: The president's decision is dangerous.
sentences.zh: 总统的决定是危险的。

sentences.en: I believe it is a catastrophic mistake.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个灾难性的错误。

sentences.en: Literally no one in the Washington establishment seemed to support what President Trump did.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿建制派中简直没有人支持特朗普总统的做法。

sentences.en: But it didn't end there.
sentences.zh: 但事情并没有就此结束。

sentences.en: One day after that announcement from the president, Defense Secretary Jim Mattis says he's stepping down.
sentences.zh: 在总统宣布这一消息的一天后，国防部长詹姆斯·马蒂斯宣布辞职。

sentences.en: 24 hours later, his Defense Secretary Jim Mattis announced he was resigning on principle because of the policy differences he had with the president.
sentences.zh: 24小时后，他的国防部长詹姆斯·马蒂斯宣布辞职，理由是与总统存在政策分歧，他出于原则选择辞职。

sentences.en: CBS News has learned another senior official will resign over President Trump's decision.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚广播公司新闻获悉，另一位高级官员将因特朗普总统的决定而辞职。

sentences.en: A couple of days later, Brett McGurk will be leaving his post as special presidential envoy to the Global Coalition to Counter ISIS.
sentences.zh: 几天后，布雷特·麦格克将卸任打击ISIS全球联盟总统特使职务。

sentences.en: Brett McGurk also resigned in proteSt.
sentences.zh: 布雷特·麦格克也愤而辞职。

sentences.en: And by the end of the weekend, the Trump administration, particularly on the foreign policy front, appeared to be in disarray.
sentences.zh: 到周末结束时，特朗普政府，特别是在外交政策方面，似乎已经陷入混乱。

sentences.en: Mark, why did this decision, of all the decisions that the president has made that feel impulsive,
sentences.zh: 马克，在总统做出的所有带有冲动色彩的决定中，为什么唯独这个决定，

sentences.en: seem to unify so many diverse parts of the American political and military establishment against him?
sentences.zh: 似乎让美国政治和军事建制派中如此多不同阵营的人一致反对他？

sentences.en: It's partly a question of how he did it and partly a question of the policy interests at stake.
sentences.zh: 这部分是因为他的行事方式，部分是因为所涉及的政策利益。

sentences.en: Let's take the policy side firSt.
sentences.zh: 我们先从政策面谈起。

sentences.en: By pulling out of Syria this abruptly, he raised questions about whether he was leaving a vacuum that would allow ISIS, the Islamic State, to come back in.
sentences.zh: 通过如此生硬地撤出叙利亚，他引发了人们的疑问：他是否留下了权力真空，从而让ISIS即“伊斯兰国”卷土重来？

sentences.en: ISIS could grow large once again or a group could actually converge and be worse than ISIS.
sentences.zh: ISIS可能会再次壮大，或者某个组织实际上可能汇聚起来，变得比ISIS更糟。

sentences.en: And in essence, reoccupy or destabilize the towns that American troops had liberated from ISIS.
sentences.zh: 并本质上重新占领或破坏美军从ISIS手中解放出来的城镇。

sentences.en: And by leaving, particularly in the abrupt way he's proposing to do...
sentences.zh: 而且通过撤军，特别是以他所提议的那种生硬的方式……

sentences.en: He has gifted this Christmas season, the Middle East, to Russia, to Iran, and to ISIS.
sentences.zh: 他把这个圣诞季的中东，当作礼物送给了俄罗斯、伊朗和ISIS。

sentences.en: You're essentially ceding the field to Russia and Iran.
sentences.zh: 你本质上是将战场拱手让给了俄罗斯和伊朗。

sentences.en: Two of our, if not adversaries, countries that we do not see eye to eye with.
sentences.zh: 这两个国家即使算不上我们的对手，也是我们意见不合的国家。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对如此。

sentences.en: Adversaries is not too strong a term.
sentences.zh: 用“对手”这个词一点也不过分。

sentences.en: And so I think that that was viewed, particularly by Republican hawks, as a very bad step.
sentences.zh: 因此我认为，特别是对共和党强硬派来说，这被视为非常糟糕的一步。

sentences.en: One of the things that troubled me most about this is that our closest allies in Israel are upset.
sentences.zh: 这件事最让我困扰的事情之一，就是我们在以色列最亲密的盟友感到不安。

sentences.en: It also raises issues about Israel's security, because Israel has been a big supporter of America maintaining an interest in Syria,
sentences.zh: 这也引发了关于以色列安全的问题，因为以色列一直大力支持美国在叙利亚维持利益，

sentences.en: in part so that Iran doesn't become one of the power players, Iran, of course, being the great adversary of Israel.
sentences.zh: 部分是为了防止伊朗成为权力玩家之一——当然，伊朗是以色列的死敌。

sentences.en: And without the cover of their U.S.
sentences.zh: 在失去美国盟友的庇护后，叙利亚的库尔德人……

sentences.en: allies, the Kurds in Syria.
sentences.zh: 库尔德人。

sentences.en: And then finally, and perhaps most emotionally, it was viewed as a betrayal of the Kurds.
sentences.zh: 最后，或许也是最让人感到情绪激动的是，这被视为对库尔德人的背叛。

sentences.en: The fierce fighters who helped defeat ISIS are now sitting ducks if Turkey decides to attack.
sentences.zh: 那些曾帮助击败ISIS的勇猛战士，如果土耳其决定发起进攻，现在就成了任人宰割的羔羊。

sentences.en: The Kurds are stateless people that have been an ally of the United States, both in Iraq and in Syria.
sentences.zh: 库尔德人是一个没有国家的民族，一直是美国在伊拉克和叙利亚的盟友。

sentences.en: And in Syria, they've been particularly important because these are hardened, well-trained fighters.
sentences.zh: 在叙利亚，他们尤为重要，因为他们是经验丰富、训练有素的战士。

sentences.en: They've fought alongside the United States against ISIS.
sentences.zh: 他们曾与美国并肩作战对抗ISIS。

sentences.en: They're viewed as an important ingredient in our success in pushing back ISIS.
sentences.zh: 他们被视为我们成功逼退ISIS的重要因素。

sentences.en: And they also face a very potentially grim future without the protection of the United States.
sentences.zh: 而且如果没有美国的保护，他们也将面临一个可能非常严峻的未来。

sentences.en: Why is that?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: Because the Turks, neighbors of Syria to the north, view the Kurds as a dangerous and restive minority in their own country.
sentences.zh: 因为叙利亚北部的邻国土耳其，将库尔德人视为他们自己国内一个危险且动荡不安的少数群体。

sentences.en: And they're basically determined to quash the Kurds wherever they can.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上决心在任何可能的地方镇压库尔德人。

sentences.en: So for all of those reasons, I think a lot of people, again, Democrats and Republicans alike,
sentences.zh: 因此，出于所有这些原因，我认为许多人，再次强调，无论是民主党人还是共和党人，

sentences.en: view turning our backs on the Kurds as a particularly unforgivable move at this moment.
sentences.zh: 都认为在此刻背弃库尔德人是一个极其不可饶恕的举动。

sentences.en: So it sounds like there's a very long list of policy reasons why people think this is a bit of a disaster.
sentences.zh: 听起来有一长串政策理由，让人们认为这是一场灾难。

sentences.en: There's almost nothing you've just mentioned that seems redeeming.
sentences.zh: 你刚才提到的几乎没有什么可取之处。

sentences.en: And that doesn't even touch the way the president did it.
sentences.zh: 这甚至还没有涉及总统的处理方式。

sentences.en: The way that the president went about making this decision makes our country an even bigger laughingstock than it already is in the region.
sentences.zh: 总统做出这个决定的方式，让我们的国家在这个地区显得比以往更加沦为笑柄。

sentences.en: The president didn't have what they call a proper interagency debate.
sentences.zh: 总统没有进行他们所谓的适当的跨部门辩论。

sentences.en: He blindsided his own generals with the timing of this.
sentences.zh: 他在时间上打了自己的将军们一个措手不及。

sentences.en: He did it over the objections of his defense secretary.
sentences.zh: 他是在违背国防部长反对意见的情况下这么做的。

sentences.en: He did it over the objections of his national security advisor, John Bolton.
sentences.zh: 他是在违背国家安全顾问约翰·博尔顿反对意见的情况下这么做的。

sentences.en: He did not tell our allies.
sentences.zh: 他没有通知我们的盟友。

sentences.en: He did not warn the Kurds.
sentences.zh: 他没有警告库尔德人。

sentences.en: Nor did he frankly consult with anyone on Capitol Hill.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，他也没有与国会山的任何人协商。

sentences.en: So in effect, every single mechanical thing that he could have done to roll this out in an orderly and thoughtful manner, he did not do.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，所有本可以用来以有序和深思熟虑的方式推出这一政策的常规手段，他全都没有采用。

sentences.en: And that, as much as anything else, helped fuel this overwhelmingly negative reaction.
sentences.zh: 这一点，和其他任何事情一样，推波助澜地引发了这种压倒性的负面反应。

sentences.en: So given all that, why would the president do it and do it now and this way?
sentences.zh: 鉴于这一切，总统为什么要这么做？为什么要现在做？为什么要用这种方式？

sentences.en: Well, the precise motives are still a little bit mysterious because the president hasn't spoken in any detail about why now.
sentences.zh: 嗯，具体的动机仍然有点神秘，因为总统没有详细说明为什么是现在。

sentences.en: But a couple of things are obvious.
sentences.zh: 但有几点是显而易见的。

sentences.en: I want to get out.
sentences.zh: 我想离开。

sentences.en: I want to bring our troops back home.
sentences.zh: 我想把我们的军队带回国内。

sentences.en: I want to start rebuilding our nation.
sentences.zh: 我想开始重建我们的国家。

sentences.en: One is President Trump has always felt this way.
sentences.zh: 首先是特朗普总统一直都是这种看法。

sentences.en: We have nothing, nothing except death and destruction.
sentences.zh: 我们一无所有，除了死亡和毁灭，什么都没有。

sentences.en: It's a horrible thing.
sentences.zh: 这是一件可怕的事情。

sentences.en: He has always been opposed to American military involvement in foreign conflicts.
sentences.zh: 他一直反对美国军事介入外国冲突。

sentences.en: George Bush made a mistake.
sentences.zh: 乔治·布什犯了个错误。

sentences.en: We can make mistakes.
sentences.zh: 我们都会犯错。

sentences.en: But that one was a beauty.
sentences.zh: 但那一次可真漂亮。

sentences.en: We should have never been in Iraq.
sentences.zh: 我们本不该卷入伊拉克。

sentences.en: We have destabilized the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 我们 destabilized the Middle East（破坏了中东的稳定）。

sentences.en: Remember, he was against the Iraq war.
sentences.zh: 记住，他一直反对伊拉克战争。

sentences.en: We should have never gone in and destabilized the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 我们本不该介入并破坏中东的稳定。

sentences.en: He campaigned on bringing troops home from Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 他在竞选时承诺从阿富汗撤军。

sentences.en: Look at Syria.
sentences.zh: 看看叙利亚。

sentences.en: Look at the migration.
sentences.zh: 看看移民问题。

sentences.en: Look at Iraq.
sentences.zh: 看看伊拉克。

sentences.en: What a mess.
sentences.zh: 简直是一团糟。

sentences.en: Look at Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 看看阿富汗。

sentences.en: What a mess.
sentences.zh: 简直是一团糟。

sentences.en: Look at everything.
sentences.zh: 看看所有这一切。

sentences.en: He's tweeted that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他在推特上说美国

sentences.en: has no place in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 在阿富汗没有立足之地。

sentences.en: He's tweeted negatively about the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他在推特上对美国在叙利亚的角色发表了负面看法。

sentences.en: role in Syria.
sentences.zh: 叙利亚的角色。

sentences.en: So we're on track now to spend, listen to this, $6 trillion.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在正走在花费——听好了——6万亿美元的路上。

sentences.en: $6 trillion.
sentences.zh: 6万亿美元。

sentences.en: He believes as a general principle that American involvement in these foreign wars is expensive.
sentences.zh: 他作为一个基本原则坚信，美国卷入这些海外战争代价高昂。

sentences.en: Could have rebuilt our country twice.
sentences.zh: 本可以把我们的国家重建两次。

sentences.en: Is ill-advised and runs counter to an America first foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 这是不明智的，并且违背了“美国优先”的外交政策。

sentences.en: So that's where he is philosophically.
sentences.zh: 这就是他在哲学层面的立场。

sentences.en: What happens then is he has a telephone conversation with the president of Turkey,
sentences.zh: 接着发生的是，他与土耳其总统埃尔多安通了电话，

sentences.en: President Erdogan, who says to him, in essence, we'll take care of this for you.
sentences.zh: 埃尔多安总统本质上对他说：“我们会为你处理好这件事。”

sentences.zh: 因为大多数人似乎确实希望美国保持警惕，将伊斯兰国遏制住，并采取一切必要措施确保我们免受伊斯兰国的袭击。

sentences.en: I think the president's objection here is that when he agreed to go along with it, his agreement was, we're there to vanquish ISIS and drive ISIS out of the towns that they occupy.
sentences.zh: 我认为总统对此的异议在于，当他同意介入时，我们的共识是：我们在那里是为了击溃伊斯兰国，将他们赶出所占领的城镇。

sentences.en: And we've done that.

sentences.en: Less than 1% of the territory that ISIS held in Syria is still in the hands of the Islamic state.
sentences.zh: 伊斯兰国在叙利亚控制的领土中，目前落入极端组织手中的还不到1%。

sentences.en: So by his own very transactional view, we've accomplished our goal.
sentences.zh: 因此，从他那种高度结果导向的视角来看，我们已经完成了目标。

sentences.en: We've won.

sentences.en: And I think from his cost-benefit analysis, he literally doesn't understand what an American soldier is supposed to do in a territory once he's driven out the enemy.

sentences.en: So I think on those grounds, he simply doesn't see a reason for us to still be in Syria.

sentences.en: So if this decision upsets everyone, including his own political base, this has to be seen as a pretty significant miscalculation.

sentences.en: Big difference.

sentences.zh: 这就是现实开始显现，你必须做好规划。

sentences.en: And the bottom line here is we want to make sure we get this right, that ISIS doesn't come back.
sentences.zh: 这里最底线的一点是，我们要确保万无一失，确保伊斯兰国不会卷土重来。

sentences.en: And I applaud the president for reevaluating what he's doing.
sentences.zh: 我为总统重新评估自己的做法点赞。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，而且不需要绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》App时，你在App里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订户每天都能获取什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订户，今天就下载《时报》App，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: I may declare a national emergency dependent on what's going to happen over the next few days.
sentences.zh: 我可能会根据接下来几天发生的事情宣布国家紧急状态。

sentences.en: On Sunday, President Trump said he was considering declaring the situation at the border to be
sentences.zh: 周日，特朗普总统表示他正在考虑宣布边境局势进入

sentences.en: a national emergency, which would allow him to begin construction of his proposed border wall without the approval of Congress.
sentences.zh: 国家紧急状态，这将使他能够在未经国会批准的情况下开始修建他提议的边境墙。

sentences.en: The president's remarks come as talks to end the government shutdown, remain at an impasse,
sentences.zh: 总统发表此番言论之际，旨在结束政府关门的谈判正陷入僵局，

sentences.en: in large part because of the president's demand that any spending bill include $5 billion for the wall.
sentences.zh: 很大程度上是因为总统要求任何开支法案都要包含50亿美元的建墙资金。

sentences.en: The shutdown is now in its third week.
sentences.zh: 政府关门现在已经进入第三周。

sentences.en: How close are we to ending the shutdown?
sentences.zh: 我们距离结束政府关门还有多远？

sentences.en: Well, I can't say that we're close because the president's made it clear he doesn't care.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不能说我们已经接近尾声，因为总统已经明确表示他根本不在乎。

sentences.en: He's prepared to see a shutdown for months, and he even said years and reaffirmed that before the cameras.
sentences.zh: 他已经做好让政府关门数月的准备，甚至还说过数年，并且在镜头前再次确认了这一点。

sentences.en: It was stunning to hear a president of the United States say that about his own government.
sentences.zh: 听到美国总统对自己的政府说出这样的话，真是令人震惊。

sentences.en: The government reelected him to lead.
sentences.zh: 选民重新选他来领导国家。

sentences.en: But that is his position.
sentences.zh: 但这确实是他的立场。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbar.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个控制严密的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称为改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党陷入了一场激烈、混乱、有时又令人兴奋的权力之争。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》节目中，我是主持人莎拉·科尼格，我们将为您讲述人们试图维持其影响力却在过程中逐渐失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 都市。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
